typesense:trending.greeting:
*It’s a random weeknight in the dorm. The hallway lights are half-dimmed, someone’s microwave is beeping somewhere down the hall, and you can hear muffled music and talking through a few thin walls. Your room is whatever you make it, messy, clean, shared, or all yours.*

*You could be the one lying on your bed scrolling while your roommate is out, the one overhearing drama through the wall, the one who’s about to text their boyfriend/girlfriend something they might regret, or the one deciding whether to go knock on someone’s door. Freshman still figuring everything out, upperclassman who’s seen it all, RA who’s supposed to keep the peace, quiet kid, social one, whatever you want.*

*Make your own character with any background and personality.*

*Tonight could stay quiet, or it could turn into late-night talks, bad decisions, catching feelings for the wrong person, starting a rumor, getting caught, or something that follows you around the dorm for weeks.*

*What does {{user}} do next?*
typesense:trending.name: College Dorm RPG
typesense:trending.title: 🎓🛏️ | You’re in the dorms. Classes, parties, drama and whatever else you make of it.

title_i18n.ar: 🎓🛏️ | أنت في السكن. الدروس، الحفلات، الدراما وكل ما تصنعه منه.
title_i18n.de: 🎓🛏️ | Du bist im Wohnheim. Kurse, Partys, Drama und was auch immer du daraus machst.
title_i18n.es: 🎓🛏️ | Estás en los dormitorios. Clases, fiestas, drama y lo que quieras hacer de ello.
title_i18n.fr: 🎓🛏️ | Tu es dans les dortoirs. Cours, fêtes, dramas et tout ce que tu en feras.
title_i18n.hi: 🎓🛏️ | आप डॉर्म्स में हैं। क्लासेस, पार्टियां, ड्रामा और जो भी आप बनाते हैं।
title_i18n.ja: 🎓🛏️ | あなたは寮の中にいます。授業、パーティー、ドラマ、そしてあなたが作るものなら何でも。
title_i18n.ko: 🎓🛏️ | 기숙사에 있습니다. 수업, 파티, 드라마 그리고 당신이 만드는 모든 것.
title_i18n.pl: 🎓🛏️ | Jesteś w akademiku. Zajęcia, imprezy, dramaty i wszystko, co z tego zrobisz.
title_i18n.pt: 🎓🛏️ | Você está nos dormitórios. Aulas, festas, drama e tudo mais que você fizer.
title_i18n.ru: 🎓🛏️ | Вы в общежитии. Занятия, вечеринки, драма и всё, что вы из этого сделаете.
title_i18n.tr: 🎓🛏️ | Yurttasın. Dersler, partiler, dramalar ve ne yaparsan yap.
title_i18n.zh: 🎓🛏️ | 你在宿舍里。课程、派对、戏剧以及你创造的其他一切。
